feeds.title: Culture Type
feeds.description: CULTURE TYPE is an essential resource focused on visual art from a Black perspective. The site features coverage of up-and-coming, established, and historic artists, and a dynamic mix of book and exhibition reviews, art news, museum coverage, auction results, and Culture Talks - exclusive interviews with innovative figures in the art world about artistic vision, institutional leadership, and pivotal cultural moments.

feeds.title: BLACK ART IN AMERICA
feeds.description: BAIA amplifies thought-provoking commentary on today's visual arts news from a variety of perspectives, including breaking news, gallery meet-ups, market trends, and profiling leading (and emerging) Black visual artists in the country. BLACK ART IN AMERICA (BAIA) is a leading online portal and network focused on African-American Art.

feeds.title: African Digital Art
feeds.description: African Digital Art is a celebration of African culture of art, design, and technology. Created and developed by Jepchumba, the platform covers a wide range of artistic production from; audio/visual production, animation, interactive projects, web, film, graphic art and design.

feeds.title: Black Art Designer Fashion
feeds.description: Original Black Art Fashion Designer Images made by Shurvon Alicia, The Fine Arts Visionary!!!!

feeds.title: Oya Arts
feeds.description: My name is Karen Alleyne, and I am a self-taught, artist originally from North West London. I specialize in black art from a British, African American, and Caribbean perspective. Follow the blog to find out more about my Afrocentric art, and the story behind the name 'Oya Arts.'

feeds.title: The Black Curation Blog
feeds.description: The Black Curation is a website dedicated to showcasing Black-owned art galleries, Black art, and travel. The author shares snippets from her adventures to art fairs, exhibitions, and visits to Black-owned art galleries.

feeds.title: MoMAA Blog
feeds.description: This blog Museum of Modern African Art delves into a host of art-related topics like Culture, History, Photography, Lifestyle, Investment, and more. Get acquainted with prominent African history and artists with these articles. MoMAA is a portal into the world of the African Modern Artist, exhibiting an artful blend of eloquence, cultural savoir-faire, and an enviable cache of worldly experiences.

feeds.title: DailyArt Magazine » Black artists
feeds.description: The following section of DailyArt Magazine features articles representing and shining a light on Black artists of the era. Since 2016 DailyArt Magazine is the place where art history gains the voice it deserves. Our mission is to present art history stories in the most compelling and fun way. We want to serve you a daily dose of beauty and inspiration based on the genius and talent of the great artists of the past.

feeds.title: Nando's Creativity » Art
feeds.description: We tell stories of our Southern African history and culture - the heartbeat of our soul. Nando's has been investing in art and artist development since 2001. Today, the Nando's Art Initiative includes 5 different artist development programmes and we support more than 350 artists on a regular basis.

feeds.title: Overdue Recognition Art Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Thompson has appeared on various panels informing the public about art collecting. Her commitment to art as an essential part of life, it gives her the means to exhibit, collect, preserve and encourage art. Establish 1999, Overdue Recognition Art Gallery proudly represents over 40 renowned and emerging African American Artist. We specialize in everything from Originals to Fine Art Reproductions.

feeds.title: The Black Art Depot Blog
feeds.description: The Black Art Depot was founded in 2004 in Atlanta, GA by Kani Saburi Ayubu. Our goal is to be the number one supplier of African-American art, gifts, collectibles, and African decor in the world. We believe that our products can be used as a tool to turn houses into homes, motivate and inspire lost souls, and bring happiness into the hearts of others.

feeds.title: Ken'Art Blog
feeds.description: Decorate your space with originality, and participate in the promotion of African art. Find gallery quality art prints by African artists at great prices. Ken'Art is an emerging company in the interior space decorating industry providing interior designers, individuals and companies with distinctive and premium quality paintings for inspiring decor.

feeds.title: ISE-DA
feeds.description: ISE-DA is an art advisory and media platform focused on supporting international Black contemporary art. With a focus on cultural stewardship through art collecting, our goal is a connected community of young Black collectors, artists, curators, and enthusiasts who are informed about and invested in the progression of Black cultural production across the diaspora.

feeds.title: Sugarcane Magazine
feeds.description: Sugarcane Magazine is a Black art and culture media company. With the rise in Black visual art along with music, dance, design, and literature, Sugarcane Magazine controls the cultural currency of Black people. Subscribe the blog and get the latest updates on Black Art.

feeds.title: CasildART Blog
feeds.description: CasildART Contemporary invites art enthusiasts to explore its engaging blogs, featuring stories of artists' journeys and the inspirations behind their creations. Established in 2017, CasildART is a Black-led organization addressing the underrepresentation of Black artists. It offers opportunities for individuals of African or Caribbean descent to reconnect with their heritage and participate in the vibrant creative landscape.
